Geographies Served Programs Sterilisation Programme District Mumbai Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra Sterilisation is a crucial measure in preventing suffering, prolonging female animals' lives, and reducing fights and injuries among males. It is internationally recognized as the most humane and effective approach to controlling the population and curbing the spread of diseases. In Mumbai, where millions of street dogs reside, Animals Matter to Me is actively involved in improving the welfare of stray and abandoned dogs by tackling overpopulation and preventing more dogs from becoming strays. It receives dogs and cats from the public, as well as through its dedicated animal rescue and volunteer teams. Additionally, the sterilisation programme has been extended to suburban Mumbai, which is home to a substantial population of around 10 lakh street dogs. Medical Care Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Animals Matter To Me operates a comprehensive medical care programme, providing state-of-the-art rehabilitation facilities for strays and abandoned pets. Its 44000 sq ft. facility in Malad West, Mumbai is equipped with advanced veterinary equipment and staffed by trained professionals, accommodating up to 300 animals. The facility includes an emergency ward for critical cases, a spay/neuter programme to control the animal population, in-house recovery units, pathology services for assessment, X-ray and laparoscopy units for diagnosis and surgeries, annual vaccinations, and health check-ups. It promptly responds to calls and emails, prioritizing emergencies such as accidents, poisonings, wounds, and cruelty cases. After working hours, external veterinary clinics are utilized for critical cases until stable, and then the animals are transported to its hospital for further treatment. Rescue Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Animals Matter to Me operates a full-fledged rescue programme, providing assistance to distressed animals in various scenarios. Whether it's an unfortunate creature injured by a vehicle or an abandoned companion left behind by its human caretaker, the organisation extends a helping hand. Its committed teams evaluate each situation meticulously, ensuring that aid is promptly dispatched to those animals requiring immediate attention and care. Animal Ambulance Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra The Animal Ambulance programme operated by Animals Matter to Me aids in sterilization and critical emergencies. It rescues and returns various animals like dogs, cats, parrots, donkeys, horses, cows, elephants, goats, geese, tortoises, pigs, and rabbits. During the Malad floods, it vaccinated 2000 animals in 8 days and donated 38 tonnes of food for cattle and domestic animals. CSR Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Animals Matter to Me encourages CSR partnerships for businesses and organisations to engage in activities such as shelter work, fostering animals, and assisting in business functions. It conducts awareness programmes and provides guidance on animal handling. Contributions support emergency medical care, free sterilisation/vaccination drives, animal ambulance services, medicines, hospital maintenance, meals for rescued animals, medical equipment, operational costs, and facility construction.
